那是一个中年大叔，穿着很是考究，一副气度不凡的样子，怀里还抱着一个长条状的物品，看形状，应该是一幅画卷。

让吴姜停下脚步的原因是，那幅画卷上隐隐散发出一股淡淡的阴气波动。

吴姜心中一动，来了兴致，跟在了中年人的身后。

中年人神色紧绷，步履匆匆，只是在一楼打量了一圈，没有过多停留，径直顺着楼梯上了二楼。

吴姜不远不近的跟在中年人的身后，想看看中年人的目的地。

中年人似乎并未察觉自己被人跟随，上了二楼后，目光快速扫过走廊两侧的店铺招牌，片刻后便径直走进了一家挂着“墨韵轩”牌匾的店铺。

看中年人的样子，对古玩城的布局很熟悉，应该也是古玩城的常客了。

吴姜眼底掠过一丝诧异，没想到中年人的目的地是这里。墨韵轩正是李叔经营古玩字画的店铺，隔壁就是他家的墨香居了。

吴姜也抬步走了进去，此刻，正有一个伙计在招呼中年人。

伙计看到有人进来，抬头刚想打招呼，看到进来的是吴姜，顿时松了口气，笑着摆了摆手：“小姜，你怎么来了？李叔和芽芽可是都不在的。”

李叔店里的伙计叫张军，跟了李叔也是很多年了，自然是认识吴姜的。

“张哥，你别管我，招呼客人就好，我闲着没事，随便转转。”吴姜说完，就开始看起了墙上挂着的字画。

张军笑了笑，收回目光，转头对着中年人笑着问道：“老板贵姓，请问有什么需要的？”

中年人微微颔首，很干脆的说道：“我姓秦，我这里有幅古画要出手，你们这里收吗？”

It was a middle-aged uncle, very well-dressed, with an extraordinary air. He was holding a long object in his arms. Judging from the shape, it should be a picture scroll.

What made Wu Jiang stop was that there was a faint wave of Yin Qi faintly emanating from the scroll.

Wu Jiang's heart moved, he became interested, and followed the middle-aged man.

The middle-aged man looked tense and walked in a hurry. He just looked around on the first floor without stopping too much, and went straight up the stairs to the second floor.

Wu Jiang followed the middle-aged man not far away, wanting to see where the middle-aged man was going.

The middle-aged man didn't seem to notice that he was being followed. After going up to the second floor, his eyes quickly scanned the store signs on both sides of the corridor. After a while, he walked straight into a store with a "Mo Yunxuan" plaque.

Judging from the appearance of the middle-aged man, he is very familiar with the layout of the antique city, and he should be a frequent visitor to the antique city.

A trace of surprise flashed across Wu Jiang's eyes. He didn't expect the middle-aged man's destination to be here.Mo Yunxuan is Uncle Li's shop that sells antiques, calligraphy and paintings, and his Moxiangju is next door.

Wu Jiang also stepped in. At this moment, a waiter was greeting the middle-aged man.

When the clerk saw someone coming in, he raised his head and was about to say hello. When he saw that it was Wu Jiang who came in, he was relieved and waved his hand with a smile: "Xiao Jiang, why are you here? Uncle Li and Yaya are not here."

The clerk in Uncle Li's shop is named Zhang Jun. He has been with Uncle Li for many years, so he naturally knows Wu Jiang.

"Brother Zhang, please leave me alone and just greet the guests. I have nothing to do, so I can just wander around." After Wu Jiang finished speaking, he began to look at the calligraphy and paintings hanging on the wall.

Zhang Jun smiled, looked away, turned to the middle-aged man and asked with a smile: "What's your name, boss? What do you need?"

The middle-aged man nodded slightly and said simply: "My surname is Qin. I have an ancient painting for sale. Will you accept it?"
